description: barochart-js (Rust JS-semantics kernel) compared with JavaScript engines on seeded corpora; with --engines every engine is compared with the kernel built for its platform (v8 and jsc: ECMA number dialect r, quickjs: QuickJS number dialect q); written by node scripts/rust/conformance.mjs --report (M1 plan Task 4)

knownDivergences.date-utc-folded-year: Date.UTC whose month-folded year lies outside -271821..275760: the kernel returns NaN like QuickJS, while V8 and JSC still compute a value when large time fields bring it back into range (M1 Task 3 ruling; applies to the v8 and jsc comparisons)
knownDivergences.unicode-version: toLowerCase input with code points assigned in the kernel Unicode version but not in this Node (UNICODE_UPGRADE): the kernel answer differs from Node only where those code points can change it, namely their own lowercase (one code point) and a neighboring final sigma (applies to the v8 comparison)
